review.notes: Full review. Gate at 4da4065 fails: sorry-data=6, prnum=4, build=1 (Lake module-system warning); depcheck 0 problems, no UPWARD/CYCLE; no edits outside the folder. P1: six sorry'd defs carry every theorem of the Lean file (R01); the route to finite-level reciprocity (4.2) lacks Fesenko's axioms (A4a)/(A4c) and the Artin–Schreier-tree argument, and (A3b) fails for Q_p(zeta_p){{t}} (R02). P2: MilnorK stand-in copies K2SymbolsBrauer §5.4 (R03); higherTopology canonical only for char K_{n-1}=p per Zhukov 1.3.1(c) (R04); existence/separation theorems elaborate without CharP (R05); Vostokov's formula cited without p>2 (R06). P3: Invitation chapter numbers wrong (§4/§5 should be §6/§10) (R07); PR numbers in README and docstrings (R08); README has zero Checks and no Needs lines, iteratedResidue undeclared (R09); module header for the build warning (R10); worked-example and API padding in Lean (R11); 3.2 route names the rank-one unit filtration instead of Fesenko's rank-n one (R12). Sample: 15 targets checked against Invitation §§1, 6, 7, 8, 10 (zhukov2000, 5917d0fc, fesenko2000parshin, vostokov2000, fesenko2000explicit); all K2SymbolsBrauer, FunctionFieldArithmetic, ClassFieldTheory, FormalLaurentPuiseux citations resolved; 16 library declarations opened at the pins; adversarial table with 19 rows. Not readable: Fesenko 1991a/b, 2001; Parshin 1984; Vostokov 1985 (needs-references.toml); Neukirch ANT and Serre Local Fields uncertified.
